editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: ThinkMarkets is a legitimate ASIC/FCA/CySEC-regulated broker scoring 7.4/10 from NAFT in 2026. ThinkZero account offers 0.0 pips + $7 RT, $0 minimum deposit removes all barriers, and the ThinkTrader proprietary platform is genuinely impressive. ThinkCopy adds social trading. Limited brand awareness and 71% retail loss rate hold it back. Best for traders wanting a modern proprietary platform alongside MT4/MT5 with no deposit requirement.
